items.source:
Return suggestions for actual bean property names that closely match
the invalid property name, if any.
items.translation: 如果存在无效的属性名称，请返回与无效属性名称非常接近的实际 Bean 属性名称的建议。

items.source: possibleMatches - suggestions for actual bean property names that closely match the invalid property name
items.translation: possibleMatches - 与无效属性名称高度匹配的实际 Bean 属性名称建议

items.source: Rod Johnson, Alef Arendsen, Arjen Poutsma

Exception thrown on an attempt to set the value of a property that
is not writable (typically because there is no setter method).
items.translation: 在尝试设置不可写属性的值时抛出异常（通常是因为没有 setter 方法）。
